blurb: Our resort is more than a place to stay - it is a place our family has poured our heart into. Located in Gold Beach, Oregon, where the river meets the ocean, Turtle Rock was created for people who want to slow down, reconnect, and experience the beauty of the Southern Oregon Coast in a peaceful and memorable way.
